Why MeshOptimiser

Heavy CAD in. A fast page out.

  • Made for CAD

    STEP comes in with its names, colours and the whole part tree. Nothing is flattened.

  • Finds by shape

    Repeats, hidden screws and tiny parts are found by what they are, not by what the file called them.

  • Nothing is final

    Every step previews first and has an undo, so you can try anything.

  • Stays with you

    It runs on your computer and nothing is uploaded. Free and open source.

Clean-up tools

Advanced STEP clean-up tools, free in your browser.

All features

Try it

Search is how you get around.

The app’s own search. Type a part, a library item, a command or a sum.

    ↑↓ choose↵ runEsc clear12*25.4 · 2 in · a part’s name

    • search everythingParts, library items, commands and settings, all from one box.
    • calculate and convertType a sum or a length. 12*25.4 is 304.8, and 2 in is 50.8 mm.
    • toggle right thereSwitch things on and off in the results, without opening a menu.
    • learn the keysEvery command shows its shortcut, so you pick them up as you search.

    Press B. Slide. Let go.

    Try it

    The commands come to you.

    The app’s own Quick wand. Point at a slice, click a command. Select a part and the ring changes to fit it.

    • PointA slice lights up. A group fans its commands out.
    • ClickRuns the command. Click a part first to work on it.
    • Hold WThe ring comes to the pointer. Let go on a slice to run it.
    • EscBack to the middle. Runs nothing.

    Latest release

    v0.34.0Bled

    Full changelog

    Animate gets a timeline along the bottom and a motion for pistons. Claude can read and write notes. The axis tools of Cinema 4D arrive, a selected group shows its parts softly, and the Windows download can carry Python inside.

    • NewA timeline along the bottom. Animate is a drawer set out like a video editor: a ruler, a row for every animated object and a bar for every motion. Drag the ruler or the playhead to scrub; drag the end of a bar to change its repeats and the bar to change its delay.
    • NewOscillate, for pistons, rockers and pumps. A to-and-fro on all three axes of shift and of turn at once, perfectly loopable. Waves: Sine, Piston (a crank turning a rod), Eased and Triangle, with lags that turn X and Y into circles and ellipses.
    • NewAnimation leaves the app. Include animation writes every moving part into a GLB or glTF as keyframes, and the timeline can be rendered to a WebM video. An Animation card in the right column plays, pauses, plays backwards and loops three ways.
    • NewAxis Center and the Axis card. Centre the axis of a part and reset its rotation, move the axis or the object to the origin, the selection or the view, align the axis to the world, its parent or the part’s faces, reset the scale. One undo step each, and the shape never moves.
